sloka: न हि प्रव्रजिते रामे जीविष्यति मही पतिः ।मृते दशरथे व्यक्तम् विलोपः तत् अनन्तरम् ॥२-४८-२६॥
transliteration: na hi pravrajite rāme jīviṣyati mahī patiḥ ।mṛte daśarathe vyaktam vilopaḥ tat anantaram ॥2-48-26॥

translations.english: Now that Rama has been banished, the king will not live (long). After his death there will be evidently only lamentations.
